Hi @eng-71, on TEXTKIT-109 (closest_match) my acceptance test fails: closest_match('dgo',['dig','log']) expects None but returns 'dig', while closest_match('cta',['cat','act']) expects 'cat'. Did the design review decide closest_match should use pure Levenshtein (no transposition), or treat transpositions specially? What distance semantics should I use?
